items.text: Nvidia said on Thursday, Nov. 12, that co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member effective immediately, ending 33 years as CEO; CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent successor.

sources.title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
sources.quote: has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately

sources.title: Nvidia CEO resigns amid scandal; CFO named interim
sources.quote: initiated a search to find a permanent successor to Huang

items.text: Nvidia shares fell as much as 14% on the resignation news on Nov. 12.

sources.title: Nvidia CEO resigns amid scandal; CFO named interim
sources.quote: Nvidia shares down as much as 14%

items.text: Nvidia closed Nov. 12 at $166.19, down 4.34%, on volume of 734.3 million shares, well above its three-month average (Yahoo Finance).

sources.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 12: Nvidia Shares Slide on Reports of CEO Jensen Huang's Resignation
sources.quote: closed at $166.19, falling 4.34%

sources.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 12: Nvidia Shares Slide on Reports of CEO Jensen Huang's Resignation
sources.quote: Trading volume reached 734.3 million shares

items.text: The week's slide began after Nvidia's board said on Sunday, Nov. 8, it was opening an independent investigation following reports that Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort (Reuters).

sources.title: Nvidia probes whether CEO Huang was target of foreign spying as he admits affair
sources.quote: The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.

items.text: In a Nov. 8 email to employees that Nvidia published, Huang admitted to an affair, writing that there was no excuse for what he did.

sources.title: A Message to Our Company
sources.quote: There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.

items.text: The New York Times reported in October that Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, a former executive of Singapore-based Megaspeed, according to Reuters.

sources.title: Nvidia probes whether CEO Huang was target of foreign spying as he admits affair
sources.quote: The New York Times reported last month that Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, an unrelated former executive of Singapore-based company Megaspeed.

items.text: Attorney General Todd Blanche said on Thursday the Justice Department had not concluded whether the woman is a spy, per Fox Business.

sources.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia stock loses billions in value this week
sources.quote: had not arrived at a conclusion regarding whether the woman is a spy

items.text: As of Friday morning, Schwab said Nvidia shares were down 11% for the week and 19% for the month.

items.text: Huang's own Nvidia holdings lost more than $20 billion in value this week on paper, Fox Business calculated.

reels.hook: Nvidia's CEO of 33 years quit. Shares sank 14%.
reels.why: The leadership exit hit the world's AI-chip leader five days before its earnings.

reels.hook: Bernstein just cut its Nvidia target from $400 to $200.
reels.why: Big downgrades show how much the CEO exit changed the risk picture for analysts.
